current_scope: adds or changes REQ/NFR/ADR records of judge-jev, plan-anchor or another sc-agent-based tool
proposed_scope: adds or edits a REQ, NFR or ADR record of judge-jev, plan-anchor or another decidr-based tool (e.g. REQ-JEV-*, files under docs/requirements/, docs/nfr/, docs/adr/ or docs/<crate>/requirements/); adds, moves or rewords text about log placement or log root, model resolution, consent, retries or result-line fields in any record; adds or edits an sc-agent record that states a rule for all decidr-based tools

current_scope: adds or changes a tool's table definitions, schema versions, or crates/sc-agent-py
proposed_scope: adds or edits CREATE TABLE or ALTER TABLE SQL, a migration, or a schema-version constant or column for a tool's tables (judge-jev, plan-anchor or another tool); changes how a tool's schema version relates to the core schema version; adds or edits SQL, table definitions or schema-version code in crates/sc-agent-py

current_scope: adds or changes code in judge-jev, plan-anchor or the client template that both tools use
proposed_scope: adds or changes source code in sc-agent crates (crates/sc-agent*, crates/decidr and the other crates/ members), judge-jev, plan-anchor, or the client template both tools use; adds a helper, parser or function that does the same job as one in another file or tool; copies, ports or vendors code from one file, crate or tool into another

current_scope: adds or changes SQL table definitions anywhere in the workspace
proposed_scope: adds or edits CREATE TABLE, ALTER TABLE or CREATE INDEX SQL, or a migration file, in any crate; adds or changes a core table (e.g. sessions, responses) or its SQL in crates/sc-agent-schema; adds SQLite storage code (e.g. sc-agent-sqlite) that creates or alters tables
